wiki_acceptance: After save->load, a fine bed is still fine (not reverted to default).

GAP-1.save_data_status: ABSENT — SaveData has no BedSave list at all
GAP-1.impact: BedQuality.Fine is not written to save.json; after load the bed defaults to BedQuality.Wood

GAP-2.save_data_status: ABSENT — SaveData has no StockpileSave list
GAP-2.impact: StockpilePriority.Critical is not written to save.json; after load priority reverts to Normal

GAP-3.save_data_status: PARTIAL — TreeSave only stores position (Vector2), no species field
GAP-3.impact: TreeSpecies.Oak is not written to save.json; after load species reverts to Pine (default)

GAP-4.save_data_status: ABSENT — SaveData has no WallSave list
GAP-4.impact: WallMaterial.Stone is not written to save.json; after load material reverts to Wood (default)

FLAG.for: QA + dedicated future serialization CODE wave
FLAG.action_required: Add BedSave (position + quality int) list to SaveData; add StockpileSave (position + priority int) list to SaveData; add species int field to TreeSave; add WallSave (position + material int) list to SaveData. Then re-run V9SaveLoadRoundTripTest — it will PASS when all four fields are in the serialized payload.
FLAG.do_not_widen_this_lane: Lane C is verify-only (W-M4-01). SaveLoadManager.cs and entity .cs files must NOT be edited in this lane.

notes: SaveLoadManager.cs (SaveData class) confirmed: only serializes wood, food, List<PawnSave> (name/pos/food/sleep/mood), List<TreeSave> (position only). All four entity sub-states (BedQuality/StockpilePriority/TreeSpecies/WallMaterial) are absent from the payload. Test seeds Fine bed + Critical stockpile + Oak tree + Stone wall, calls Save(), calls Load(), and asserts each field is present in the returned SaveData — all four assertions evaluate to false, producing one FAIL that documents the exact gaps. This is the correct output for verify-only mode.
